format.description: Output size. The length follows the cut transcript plus the end card.

ratio.description: 9:16 reframes landscape footage to vertical around reframe.focus_x; 16:9 keeps it landscape.

media.description: The source files, relative to the params file. They are copied into the project's assets/media/.

footage.description: The speaker footage (any format Mosio decodes), with its own audio.

footage_size.description: Display size of the footage in pixels, for the reframe (the applier does not decode media).

transcript.description: SubRip transcript of the footage, one cue per spoken line, timed to the footage. It drives the cuts and becomes the captions.

music.description: Optional music bed (any audio Mosio decodes), at least as long as the cut video.

broll.description: Picture-only clips cut over the speaker while they keep talking.

id.description: Clip id in mosio.json. Defaults to broll-N.

src.description: The B-roll file, relative to the params file.

at_cue.description: Transcript cue the clip covers; it starts 0.2 s into the cue.

frames.description: Length in frames; defaults to the rest of the cue.

cut.description: What is cut out of the footage.

mode.description: transcript: keep every cue (padded), cut the pauses between them. keep: keep only the given ranges.

pad_s.description: transcript mode: seconds kept before and after each cue, so words are not clipped.

merge_gap_s.description: transcript mode: pauses shorter than this are kept (the cues are joined).

keep.description: keep mode: source ranges in seconds, in any order.

reframe.description: How the footage fills the frame.

focus_x.description: Horizontal position of the speaker in the footage (0 left, 1 right); 9:16 keeps it centred.

punch_in.description: Zoom on every other cut, which hides the jump between two kept segments. 1 turns it off.

mix.description: Music level (the speech plays at 0 dB).

music_db_end.description: Music gain under the end card.

duck_frames.description: Length of the equal-power crossfade between the two levels.

enabled.description: Write captions/captions.srt and burn it in with the brand colours.

end_hold_s.description: Length of the end card after the last word.

beats.description: One overlay scene per beat, in order: an a-roll lower third first, a cta end card last, callouts and numbers in between, each starting at its transcript cue.

id.description: Optional scene id (used in every data-mosio-id). Defaults to the role name; a repeated role gets -2, -3.

role.description: a-roll: the speaker's lower third (first beat). fact, proof: a callout card. number: a counting stat. cta: the end card after the speech (last beat).

text.description: The words on screen, written literally into the scene HTML. For a-roll, the speaker's name.

key.description: The word or words of the text to stress with the accent colour. Must occur in the text.

at_cue.description: Transcript cue (1-based, in the original transcript) the overlay starts with. Required for every beat but cta; ignored for the first beat, which starts at 0.

subtitle.description: a-roll: second line of the lower third (role, company).

tag.description: fact, proof: small label above the callout text. Empty for none.

value.description: number: the value the counter runs to.

suffix.description: number: text right after the value, e.g. % or x.

button.description: cta: text of the pill under the line. Empty for none.

weight.description: Kept for the shared params shape; media recipes time beats by the transcript, not by weight.

style.description: Look: brand colours, type size and motion speed.

brand.description: Brand colours. They are written to shared/tokens.css (overlays) and to the captions style in mosio.json.

bg.description: Card and end-card background, caption outline (--bg).

accent.description: Key words, the lower-third bar, the stat and the button (--accent).

text_on_accent.description: Text on the accent colour, the button label (--text-on-accent).

font_scale.description: Multiplier on every overlay and caption size (--type-scale).

files.content:
# Talking head

A speaker on camera, edited from the transcript. You bring the footage and its SubRip transcript (from any
speech-to-text tool). The recipe does the rest:

- cuts the pauses between lines (`cut.mode: transcript`), or keeps the ranges you give (`cut.mode: keep`);
- reframes landscape footage to 9:16 around the speaker (`reframe.focus_x`), with a small punch-in on every other cut
  so the jump does not show;
- burns in captions in the brand colours, retimed to the cut;
- adds a lower third, callouts, stats and an end card (the timeline overlays, each starting with a transcript cue);
- cuts picture-only B-roll over the speaker while they keep talking;
- adds a music bed that sits low under the speech and comes up for the end card.

Use it for interviews, tips, founder updates, course clips: one person talking, whose words carry the video.

## Taste

- **Let the face lead.** Overlays come and go within about four seconds and never cover the speaker's face (callouts
  sit at the top, the lower third above the captions). One overlay at a time.
- **Callouts stress, they do not repeat.** Pick the two or three claims worth remembering. Keep them to one short line,
  with the key word in the accent colour.
- **Numbers count.** Use `number` only for a figure the speaker says out loud.
- **B-roll proves what is said**, for one cue at a time. The speech keeps going under it.
- **Cut tight, not breathless.** `pad_s` 0.1–0.15 s keeps the breath before a word. Raise `merge_gap_s` to keep short,
  meaningful pauses.
- **The end card is a pause.** 2–3 s, one line and one action.

## Inputs

| Param | Notes |
|---|---|
| `media.footage` | Speaker footage with its own audio. Give `media.footage_size` if it is not 1920×1080. |
| `media.transcript` | `.srt`, one cue per line, timed to the footage. Cue numbers (1-based) are what `at_cue` refers to. |
| `media.music` | Optional. It should run at least as long as the cut video. |
| `media.broll[]` | `{src, at_cue, frames?}`: picture only, starting 0.2 s into the cue. Clips may not overlap. |
| `content.beats[]` | First `a-roll` (name + `subtitle`), last `cta` (end card); in between, `fact`, `proof` or `number`, each with `at_cue`. |

## After applying
The result is an ordinary Mosio project: edit words in place, change a brand token in `shared/tokens.css` and only the scenes that import it re-render.

# Talking head: beat plan

Length 6 to 180 s (default 20). Roles: a-roll, fact, proof, number, cta; 2 to 8 beats.
Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2, medium 3, long 4.

## a-roll

- scene: scenes/lower-third.html
- technique: accent bar grows, card wipes in, name words rise, subtitle fades; leaves after ~4 s
- primitives: bar-grow, wipe-in, rise-fade
- limits: {"max_words": 4}

## fact / proof

- scene: scenes/callout.html
- technique: card pops in near the top, tag slides, words rise one by one, underline draws
- primitives: pop, rise-fade, draw
- limits: {"max_words": 9}

## number

- scene: scenes/number.html
- technique: card pops, value counts up from zero, label words rise
- primitives: pop, count-up, rise-fade
- limits: {"max_words": 6}

## cta

- scene: scenes/end-card.html
- technique: brand end card fades over the last frame, words rise, button pops
- primitives: fade, rise-fade, pop
- limits: {"max_words": 6}

## Controls

- Speaker position (`/reframe/focus_x`): Where the 9:16 crop sits on the landscape footage: transform.x of every a-roll clip in mosio.json.
- Cut tightness (`/cut/pad_s`): How much air is kept around each line: the a-roll clip ranges, caption times and overlay starts all move, so most windows re-render.
- Accent colour (`/style/brand/accent`): Key words, bar, stat and button: --accent in shared/tokens.css, so every overlay re-renders.
- Callout text (`/content/beats/1/text`): Edit the words of one callout directly in its scene file; only that callout's windows re-render.
